about_the_game:
Welcome to Deep Space Corridor, a classic horror game about finding anomalies, with an added touch of narrative elements. You'll play as a so-called "investigator" who wakes up on a mysterious space station, tasked with inspecting a designated area to determine if any abnormal phenomena exist within it.

  • If you detect anomalies, exit through the red door at the end of the corridor.

  • If you deem the area normal, exit through the blue door at the end of the corridor.

As you make correct judgments repeatedly, the story behind the mysterious space station will gradually unfold. After making a certain number of consecutive judgments, you'll advance to the next depth of the game, uncovering more truths. Once you've fully cleared the story, a full collection mode will become available, allowing you to revisit and collect all abnormal events. Each correct judgment of an anomaly will unlock a unique achievement!

Deep Space Corridor offers a short but slightly terrifying 猎奇 (bizarre) experience (approximately 60 minutes).
The game draws inspiration from 《P.T.》, 《The Exit 8》, and 《The Cabin Factory》.
